 Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek’s Book Sales Embarrassingly Low, Sob Story Doesn't Resonate
 Shannen Ace 
 Published: October 13, 2026 
 Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek’s Book Sales Embarrassingly Low, Sob Story Doesn't Resonate
 WDWNT, LLC is a participant in the Amazon Services LLC Associates Program, an affiliate advertising program designed to provide a means for sites to earn advertising fees by advertising and linking to Amazon.com. 
 Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek’s sob story isn’t resonating with fans as his memoir hasn’t even sold 2,500 copies in its first week.
 Bob Chapek Book Sales
 According to Circana BookScan’s data, Behind the Castle Walls: My Thirty Years at the Happiest Place on Earth only sold 2,400 copies in its first week.
 That means it didn’t break into the top 10 of the New York Times Best Seller list for Nonfiction. It was #14 on the Hardcover Nonfiction list and #15 on the Combined Print & E-Book Nonfiction list.
 This is despite Chapek’s extensive media tour. He said Disney is trying to “erase” him and took credit for Josh D’Amaro’s rise to CEO . He wrote the memoir to “get the truth out there” and though he is blaming Iger for his problems , he also said he doesn’t have beef with the former CEO.
 The book was co-written by Don Yaeger. If you want to make Chapek’s sales 2,401, you can buy it here .
